COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C528 No.917 of 2025
HON’BLE ASHISH NAITHANI, J.
Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the 
Applicant.
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned AGA, for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondent nos.1 and 2.
3. Admit.
4. In the present 528 Application filed under Bhartiya 
Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the Applicant has put a 
challenge to the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.792 
of 2024, “State Vs. Siddhartha Bagri and others”, under 
Sections 304 of IPC, pending in the court of learned Chief 
Judicial Magistrate, Pauri Garhwal. 
5. Considering the submissions advanced by the learned 
counsel on behalf of the Applicant, an interference is being 
called for in the matter.
6. Issue notice to the Respondent no.3. Steps to be taken 
within a week.
7. Counter affidavit to be filed by the Respondents within 
a period of three weeks.
8. Till the next date of listing, the proceedings of Criminal 
Case No.792 of 2024, “State Vs. Siddhartha Bagri and 
others”, under Sections 304 of IPC, pending in the court of  learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pauri Garhwal, shall remain 
stayed.
9. List this matter on 28.07.2025 alongwith C528 No.946 
of 2024.
10. Stay application (IA No.1 of 2025) stands disposed of 
accordingly. 
(ASHISH NAITHANI, J.)
 23.06.2025
Nitesh/
